name: Maroondah Reservoir Park

facts.claim: A Parks Victoria-managed park below Maroondah Dam near Healesville with gardens, six rotundas and gas and electric barbecues
Easy and moderate walks start here, including the 82 Rose Steps up the dam wall

Access to the surrounding protected water catchment is prohibited; only the park, limited walking tracks and the aqueduct walk are open

name: Badger Weir

facts.claim: A picnic spot in Yarra Ranges National Park, about 15 minutes from Healesville, known for birdlife
Three easy nature walks lead from the picnic ground to Badger Creek: Coranderrk Track (1.1 km, flat, stroller friendly), Slip Creek Track (1.4 km) and Lyrebird Track (1.1 km)
Fungi appear in autumn and winter and the creek is good for cooling off in summer
